messages.confirmActivate: Turn on this journey and enroll the audience?
messages.confirmPause: Pause this journey? People already in it stop moving forward.
messages.confirmStopEnrollment: Stop adding new people to this journey?
messages.confirmArchive: Archive this journey? You usually will not turn it back on.
messages.activatedWithCounts: Journey is on · enrolled {enrolled} · skipped {skipped} · failed {failed}
messages.activationFailuresDetail: Some records failed enrollment (often entry actions). Review Journey enrollments filtered by Failed.
messages.flowEmpty: No steps yet. Start with an Entry step, then add actions and connections.
messages.reviewConfirmHint: Turning on enrolls the audience and runs Entry actions immediately.
messages.reviewBlockedHint: Fix the errors above, then open Review & turn on again.
messages.periodInvalid: Use a format like “3 days” or “12 hours”. Accepted units: minutes, hours, days, weeks.

tooltips.continuousEnrollment: While the journey is on, anyone newly added to the audience joins automatically.
tooltips.allowReEnrollment: When on, automatic enrollment creates a new run if someone who already finished, left, or failed is still in the audience. When off, that person is never auto-enrolled again (terminal run is permanent).
tooltips.goalEventCodes: When one of these events is received, count the person as goal reached and finish their run.
tooltips.goalEntityFilter: After a step runs, finish as goal reached if the person matches these fields (standard or Custom Fields).
tooltips.goalSuccessStage: Goal matches move the person into this Success step and run its actions before completing the journey.
tooltips.targetEntityType: Contacts, leads, or accounts this journey applies to.
tooltips.targetLists: People on these lists can join.
tooltips.excludeTargetLists: People on these lists never join, even if they are on an include list.
tooltips.runAsUser: Whose permissions and record ownership this journey runs with. Defaults to the creator when left empty.
